cases.cite: In re LTL Mgmt LLC, 64 F.4th 84 (3d Cir 2023)
cases.mechanism: Oct 12 2021 divisional merger under Tex. Bus. Orgs. Code 1.002(55)(A): Old Consumer split into LTL (talc liabilities) + New Consumer (assets) + Funding Agreement (LTL funded by New Consumer/J&J)
cases.holding: DISMISSED under 1112(b): not in financial distress, no valid bankruptcy purpose; only a putative debtor in financial distress may access Chapter 11

cases.mechanism: 2017 divisional merger same statute (Old GP -> Bestwall + New GP) + funding agreement (New GP covers Bestwall expenses/obligations; assets out of tort reach)
cases.holding: Distinguishes LTL (no good-faith/distress challenge raised); describes merger mechanics verbatim
